confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors come from crowd-sourced or dated aggregator figures (Expatistan, Cities Insider, an undated price comparison, and 2022-era Spanish menu-del-dia data), so they are rough. Euro figures were converted at an assumed 1.18 USD per EUR, cross-checked against Expatistan's AU$/EUR pair and the FX observation below; no live FX quote was retrieved. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not checked against live listings. The FX observation (2026-03-20) is the most recent RBA figure I could confirm from search output, not necessarily the latest available on 2026-10-16, and I did not open the RBA page itself. Refresh it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are based on Bilbao-specific aggregator data. In an undated comparison, Bilbao sits below Madrid and Barcelona on cappuccino (USD 1.85 vs 2.12 and 2.27) and beer (USD 2.95 vs 3.54), so food anchors are set at or below those cities' levels. Accommodation anchors are a holistic estimate for a mid-sized northern Spanish city with July tourism demand.
